title: Scenario Analysis
description: Scenario analysis for FIRE projections with conservative, base, and optimistic market assumptions.

scenario.description: A single scenario projection with market assumptions and resulting FIRE metrics.

annual_return.description: Assumed annual investment return rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%).

inflation_rate.description: Assumed annual inflation rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.03 for 3%).

fire_number.description: Calculated FIRE number for this scenario (annual retirement expenses / withdrawal rate).

fire_age.description: Projected age at which FIRE is achieved under this scenario.

final_assets.description: Projected portfolio value at the time of FIRE.

years_to_fire.description: Number of years from now until FIRE is achieved.

monthly_savings_needed.description: Monthly savings required to achieve FIRE by the target age in this scenario.
